Namespace osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor

Classes

BasicContextMenuContainer

ContextMenuContainer

A container which manages a osu.Framework.Graphics.UserInterface.Menu. If a right-click happens on a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable that implements osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.IHasContextMenu and exists as a child of the same osu.Framework.Input.InputManager as this container, a osu.Framework.Graphics.UserInterface.Menu will be displayed with bottom-right origin at the right-clicked position.

CursorContainer

CursorEffectContainer<TSelf, TTarget>

An abstract container type that handles positional input for many drawables of type TTarget.

PopoverContainer

TooltipContainer.Tooltip

The default tooltip. Simply displays its text on a gray background and performs no easing.

TooltipContainer

Displays Tooltips for all its children that inherit from the osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.IHasTooltip or osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.IHasCustomTooltip interfaces. Keep in mind that only children with osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.HandlePositionalInput set to true will be checked for their tooltips.

Interfaces

IHasAppearDelay

A tooltip which provides a custom delay until it appears, override the osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer-wide default.

IHasContextMenu

IHasCustomTooltip

Implementing this interface allows the implementing osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable to display a custom tooltip if it is the child of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer. Keep in mind that tooltips can only be displayed by a osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer if the osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable implementing osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.IHasCustomTooltip has osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.HandlePositionalInput set to true.

IHasCustomTooltip<TContent>

Implementing this interface allows the implementing osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable to display a custom tooltip if it is the child of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer. Keep in mind that tooltips can only be displayed by a osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer if the osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable implementing osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.IHasCustomTooltip has osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.HandlePositionalInput set to true.

IHasPopover

Interface to be implemented by UI controls that show a osu.Framework.Graphics.UserInterface.Popover on click.

IHasTooltip

Implementing this interface allows the implementing osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable to display a tooltip if it is the child of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer. The tooltip used is dependent on the implementation of the osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer.CreateTooltip method of the osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer containing this osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.

ITooltip

A tooltip that can be used in conjunction with a osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer and/or osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.IHasCustomTooltip implementation.

ITooltip<T>

A tooltip that can be used in conjunction with a osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer and/or osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.IHasCustomTooltip implementation.

ITooltipContentProvider

Marker interface for interfaces that provide tooltip content.
